decision: Production and user return remain NO-GO until every required core feature is PROD-CLEARED.

executionPolicy.externalContact: Only an exact self-owned recipient explicitly authorized in the current turn; never a customer recipient.
executionPolicy.messageReuse: Do not reuse an exact broker-response body in a later production run.
executionPolicy.promotionRule: No averaging. Any open P0 blocks traffic and user return.

evidence: Returned to https://sitesiftai.com/login and left the tab ready for sign-in.

authenticatedDashboard.evidence: The dedicated browser currently shows Continue with Microsoft rather than an authenticated dashboard.

parallelChromeControl.evidence: Two read-only connection attempts timed out before a dashboard tab could be controlled.

milestones.name: Source authority and release manifest
milestones.exitGate: GitHub, production revisions, artifact digests, configuration, traffic, and rollback targets map to exact immutable commits.

milestones.name: Release rails and browser preflight
milestones.exitGate: Exact-SHA CI, versioned coordinated deploy workflows, artifact readback, authenticated dedicated-browser control, and rollback rehearsal pass.

milestones.name: Notification and operator-action controls
milestones.exitGate: Authenticated resolve/dismiss/clear semantics deploy dark first; PROD_CLEARED is deferred until R3-R4 create a browser-launched self-owned action set for Firestore/outbox/audit readback.

milestones.name: Campaign start and mailbox readiness
milestones.exitGate: Versioned launch, mailbox preflight, capability separation, quota reservation, Sheet compensation, and truthful lifecycle pass production browser proof.

milestones.name: Core event, escalation, and projection lifecycle
milestones.exitGate: Source-bound event receipts, visible call/tour/question actions, projection recovery, dedupe, and completion gates pass production proof.

milestones.name: Firestore integrity and operational truth
milestones.exitGate: Indexes, parent/child integrity, stopped-campaign roots, notifications, outbox/audit reconciliation, health, and completion are clean or explicitly quarantined.

milestones.name: Varied historical conversation corpus
milestones.exitGate: Every core feature passes fresh, non-repeating production-style browser variants seeded from sanitized historical failures.

milestones.name: Production self-canary and staged return
milestones.exitGate: Exact deployed SHA, browser, mailbox, Firestore, Graph, Sheet, audit, notification, scheduler, and rollback evidence are clean with zero unresolved P0/P1 work.

checkpointRule: Every milestone writes a new immutable evidence entry containing code SHA, CI run, artifact digest, revision, configuration hash, traffic percentage, browser scenario IDs, exact message hashes, Firestore/Graph/Sheet readbacks, defects, rollback result, and evidence commit SHA. Prior entries are never overwritten.
